title: fix(metadata-protocol,cli,cloud-connection)!: refuse an object extension that re-declares an owner's field beyond its display properties (ADR-0146 D10)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DQCNH4WvC9WPtKsTwjY6Nrq)_

Fixes #30610

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: no move — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` already teach `fieldPatches` as the way to change a base field's display, and no page teaches taking an owner field over through `fields`; the prescription ships in the refusal text.

ADR-0087 disposition (in the changeset): `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` — a refused shape with no mechanical rewrite (which keys of a re-declared field were meant as display and which as a takeover is a judgement about the field), and no first-party artifact writes the shape (measured below). A stored row that already re-declares an owner field keeps registering with the registry's warning and is judged when next saved or published.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：模块包在 `objectExtensions[].fields` 里重新声明属主对象已有的字段（例如把 `amount` 的类型从数字改成文本、去掉必填、改成只读）时，现在在三道门被拒：元数据保存/发布/恢复（400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`）、`os validate`（退出码 1）、市场安装（422 `VALIDATION_ERROR`）。提示语点名 `fieldPatches` 和可改的展示属性白名单。
- 为什么改：ADR-0146 D10 规定基础字段只能改展示属性；但扩展在 `fields` 里写同名字段会整体替换属主字段，过去只有注册表打一条警告，任何门都不拦。
- 风险与回滚：属于收窄，但第一方产物（examples、HotCRM）实测 0 处使用这种写法；只改展示属性的重复声明照常放行，注册表警告保留。回滚即回退本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts`（判定本身，`redeclaredFieldChanges` 的比较规则是风险点），`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts` 第 7 步，`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 2e'。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全绿（类型变更被拒、只改标签放行）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（契约档复审由席位执行）。

## What changes

ADR-0146 D10, second rule: "Everything else on a base field — type, `required`, `unique`, `reference`, `defaultValue`, formulas, `options` membership — is refused on the extension with a prescription naming the whitelist." An `objectExtensions[].fields` key naming a field the extended object's owner declares replaces that field whole in `mergeObjectDefinitions` (`{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`), and before this PR no door refused it; only `reportRedeclaredFields` warned.

**One judge** — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts`, beside the `__c` judge (`judgeExtensionFieldSuffix`):

- `judgeRedeclaredOwnerFields({ packageId, objectExtensions, ownerOf, at })` returns every entry that re-declares an owner field and changes something outside `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST` (read from `@objectstack/spec/data`, never re-spelled), located, with `changed` (the keys, sorted) and the sentence.
- `redeclaredFieldChanges(extensionField, ownerField)`: both bodies are read through `FieldSchema` first (a default the parse stamps on one side is no change), then compared key by key, skipping the whitelisted keys, `name` and the ADR-0010 `_` envelope. `options` is compared as membership keyed by stored `value`, each option without its whitelisted `label`, so a relabel or reorder is no change.
- Not judged: an extension of an object its own package owns, an object with no known owner at that door, and a key the owner does not declare (an added field).
- Envelopes: `redeclaredOwnerFieldRefusalError` (`VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 with `issues[]`, the `__c` judge's envelope) and `redeclaredOwnerFieldInstallMessage` (the install door's sentence).

**Three doors call it:**

- **Publish** — `objectExtensionItemRefusal` step 7 (`protocol-object-extension-item.ts`), which the save (draft and live), the per-item and package publish, and the restore doors already ask. The owner is the registry's `getObjectOwner(target)` — its own declaration, never the resolved object, which already carries this package's earlier extension.
- **`os validate`** — `packages/cli/src/utils/extension-redeclared-owner-fields.ts` walks the artifact (each `packages[]` entry under its id, or the stack under `manifest.id`); step 3a-v-bis of `validate.ts` exits 1 with the rows on `errors` (`code: VALIDATION_ERROR`). An owner outside the artifact is judged at install.
- **Install** — `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` step 2e', on the managed and the `.custom` pair branches, beside the field-patch target check: `422 VALIDATION_ERROR`, every refusal in `details.refusals`, before any write. The owner is a package this artifact delivers, or the installed owner (`getObjectOwner`).

`reportRedeclaredFields` (`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`) is unchanged and stays a warning.

## Measurement (the card's step 1)

At `origin/main` `f4d568ba`:

- No door refuses the shape: `judgeExtensionFieldSuffix` judges only the suffix; the field-patch target check judges `fieldPatches` keys; the registry warns.
- First-party re-declarations of an owner field: **0**. `examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts` (the only extension under `examples/**`) adds `loyalty_tier`, `linkedin_url`, `csat_score`, none of which `showcase_account` declares, and extends its own package's object. `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts` extends `sys_sso_provider` with `oidc_client_secret`, which `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts` does not declare. HotCRM (`objectstack-ai/hotcrm` `6961ab1`): no `objectExtensions` anywhere.

## Tests

All at head `435f30c7`.

- **The judge** — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.test.ts`, 12 cases: refused on a `type` change, a dropped `required`, `readonly` + `defaultValue`, an added option value, the array spelling located by index; admitted on a display-only re-declaration (labels, help text, option labels, reordered options), a parse-stamped default (`required: false` against an owner that omits it), an added field, the package's own object, an unknown owner, the `_` envelope; the save doors' envelope `VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 with every entry in `issues`.
- **Publish door** — a new top-level `describe` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts` (the real-store rig: better-sqlite3 behind `ObjectQL`, the real protocol and registry), with a writable module package that depends on the base: a `type` change is refused at the save door (`VALIDATION_ERROR` / 400 at `fields.name`, no row, no extender); a draft stored before the rule is refused at publish and stays a draft; a display-only re-declaration saves and publishes.
- **`os validate`** — `packages/cli/test/validate-extension-redeclared-owner-field.test.ts` (integration tier, spawns the CLI): an assembled artifact whose second package re-declares the first's `amount` as `text` exits 1 with `packages[1].manifest.objectExtensions[0].fields.amount`, `code: VALIDATION_ERROR`, `changed: ['type']`; a label-only re-declaration validates clean.
- **Install door** — a new top-level `describe` in `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-field-patch-targets.test.ts` (the 2e harness, a real `SchemaRegistry`): a type change of the installed owner's field is refused `422 VALIDATION_ERROR` with the refusal in `details.refusals` and nothing registered, synced or written; an added option value on an owner the same artifact delivers is refused at `packages[1]…`; a display-only re-declaration installs.
- `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`: the new gate is classified in `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES`.

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time, not kept)</summary>

Committed first, then `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts`: anchor `if (changed.length === 0) continue;` (x1) replaced by `if (changed.length >= 0) continue;` (the judge refuses nothing); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build`; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` saw the marker in `dist/`.

- judge: 6 failed / 6 passed (every refusal case red)
- runtime rig: 2 failed / 20 passed (the save and publish refusals)
- install door: 2 failed / 9 passed (both refusals)
- `os validate`: 1 failed / 1 passed (the refusal)

Restored from `HEAD` (blob `e7ae83e11485` equals the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs --absent` passed over 24 built files; the runtime, install and `os validate` files green again.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `os build` does not run the check yet (`VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` row in `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`), the same build-side gap the field-patch target check carries; the install door refuses what the build emits.
- `os validate` judges only an owner declared by another package of the same artifact. A single-package module stack that extends an installed base is judged at install.
- At the install door the installed owner's declaration carries the platform columns the registry injects, so re-declaring one of those (e.g. `owner_id`) is judged there and not at `os validate`.
- In a `.custom` pair, an unsuffixed `fields` key is refused first by the `__c` judge, whose prescription already names `fieldPatches`.
